svg.title: Customer Churn MLOps — C4 container view
svg.desc: C4 container diagram: nginx serves the static Churn Desk, which runs in the analyst's browser and calls the FastAPI prediction API directly; the API loads classifier.joblib from the ./models volume at start. The worker, built from the same image, polls the Prefect server for scheduled runs, reads the dataset read-only, writes the model to ./models and logs every run to MLflow. In the opt-in monitoring profile Filebeat tails the Docker logs of the API and the worker, Logstash indexes their JSON events in Elasticsearch, a one-shot setup container creates the index template and the dashboard, and Kibana shows it to the ML engineer.
